verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֹושְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: مَتَى جِئْتُمْ إِلَى أَرْضِ مَسْكَنِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُعْطِيكُمْ،
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye are come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

verses.he: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אֹו־זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֙דֶר֙ אֹ֣ו בִנְדָבָ֔ה אֹ֖ו בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לַעֲשֹׂ֞ות רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִן־הַבָּקָ֖ר אֹ֥ו מִן־הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.ar: وَعَمِلْتُمْ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ، مُحْرَقَةً أَوْ ذَبِيحَةً، وَفَاءً لِنَذْرٍ أَوْ نَافِلَةً أَوْ فِي أَعْيَادِكُمْ، لِعَمَلِ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ مِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ أَوْ مِنَ ٱلْغَنَمِ،
verses.en: and will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt-offering, or a sacrifice, in fulfilment of a vow clearly uttered, or as a freewill-offering, or in your appointed seasons, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock;
verses.kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.web: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock—

verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֛יב הַמַּקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּנֹ֖ו לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂרֹ֔ון בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.ar: يُقَرِّبُ ٱلَّذِي قَرَّبَ قُرْبَانَهُ لِلرَّبِّ تَقْدِمَةً مِنْ دَقِيقٍ، عُشْرًا مَلْتُوتًا بِرُبْعِ ٱلْهِينِ مِنَ ٱلزَّيْتِ،
verses.en: then shall he that bringeth his offering present unto the LORD a meal-offering of a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of oil;
verses.kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth [part] of an hin of oil.
verses.web: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

verses.he: וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֙סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל־הָעֹלָ֖ה אֹ֣ו לַזָּ֑בַח לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.ar: وَخَمْرًا لِلسَّكِيبِ رُبْعَ ٱلْهِينِ. تَعْمَلُ عَلَى ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ أَوِ ٱلذَّبِيحَةِ لِلْخَرُوفِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ.
verses.en: and wine for the drink-offering, the fourth part of a hin, shalt thou prepare with the burnt-offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.kjv: And the fourth [part] of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.web: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

verses.he: אֹ֤ו לָאַ֙יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ لِلْكَبْشِ تَعْمَلُ تَقْدِمَةً مِنْ دَقِيقٍ عُشْرَيْنِ مَلْتُوتَيْنِ بِثُلْثِ ٱلْهِينِ مِنَ ٱلزَّيْتِ،
verses.en: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meal-offering two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the third part of a hin of oil;
verses.kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare [for] a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third [part] of an hin of oil.
verses.web: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

verses.he: וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَخَمْرًا لِلسَّكِيبِ ثُلْثَ ٱلْهِينِ تُقَرِّبُ لِرَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: and for the drink-offering thou shalt present the third part of a hin of wine, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third [part] of an hin of wine, [for] a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן־בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אֹו־זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֥דֶר אֹֽו־שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَإِذَا عَمِلْتَ ٱبْنَ بَقَرٍ مُحْرَقَةً أَوْ ذَبِيحَةً وَفَاءً لِنَذْرٍ أَوْ ذَبِيحَةَ سَلَامَةٍ لِلرَّبِّ،
verses.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, in fulfilment of a vow clearly uttered, or for peace-offerings unto the LORD;
verses.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock [for] a burnt offering, or [for] a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
verses.web: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,

verses.he: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל־בֶּן־הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין׃
verses.ar: تُقَرِّبُ عَلَى ٱبْنِ ٱلْبَقَرِ تَقْدِمَةً مِنْ دَقِيقٍ ثَلَاثَةَ أَعْشَارٍ مَلْتُوتَةً بِنِصْفِ ٱلْهِينِ مِنَ ٱلزَّيْتِ،
verses.en: then shall there be presented with the bullock a meal-offering of three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with half a hin of oil.
verses.kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.web: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

verses.he: וְיַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَخَمْرًا تُقَرِّبُ لِلسَّكِيبِ نِصْفَ ٱلْهِينِ وَقُودَ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And thou shalt present for the drink-offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, [for] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

verses.he: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַשֹּׁור֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד אֹ֖ו לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֹֽו־לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים אֹ֥ו בָעִזִּֽים׃
verses.ar: هَكَذَا يُعْمَلُ لِلثَّوْرِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ أَوْ لِلْكَبْشِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ أَوْ لِلشَّاةِ مِنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ أَوْ مِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ.
verses.en: Thus shall it be done for each bullock, or for each ram, or for each of the he-lambs, or of the kids.
verses.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.web: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

verses.he: כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃
verses.ar: كَٱلْعَدَدِ ٱلَّذِي تَعْمَلُونَ هَكَذَا تَعْمَلُونَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ حَسَبَ عَدَدِهِنَّ.
verses.en: According to the number that ye may prepare, so shall ye do for every one according to their number.
verses.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.web: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

verses.he: כָּל־הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה־כָּ֖כָה אֶת־אֵ֑לֶּה לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ وَطَنِيٍّ يَعْمَلُ هَذِهِ هَكَذَا، لِتَقْرِيبِ وَقُودِ رَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.web: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יָגוּר֩ אִתְּכֶ֨ם גֵּ֜ר אֹ֤ו אֲשֶֽׁר־בְּתֹֽוכְכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.ar: وَإِذَا نَزَلَ عِنْدَكُمْ غَرِيبٌ، أَوْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ فِي وَسَطِكُمْ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ وَعَمِلَ وَقُودَ رَائِحَةِ سُرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ، فَكَمَا تَفْعَلُونَ كَذَلِكَ يَفْعَلُ.
verses.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever may be among you, throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever [be] among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.web: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.

verses.he: הַקָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָכֶ֖ם וְלַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עֹולָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כָּכֶ֛ם כַּגֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: أَيَّتُهَا ٱلْجَمَاعَةُ، لَكُمْ وَلِلْغَرِيبِ ٱلنَّازِلِ عِنْدَكُمْ فَرِيضَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ دَهْرِيَّةٌ فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ. مَثَلُكُمْ يَكُونُ مَثَلَ ٱلْغَرِيبِ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: As for the congregation, there shall be one statute both for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you, a statute for ever throughout your generations; as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.kjv: One ordinance [shall be both] for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth [with you], an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye [are], so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.web: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before Yahweh.

verses.he: תֹּורָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר אִתְּכֶֽם׃ פ
verses.ar: شَرِيعَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ وَحُكْمٌ وَاحِدٌ يَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَلِلْغَرِيبِ ٱلنَّازِلِ عِنْدَكُمْ».
verses.en: One law and one ordinance shall be both for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.web: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בְּבֹֽאֲכֶם֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: مَتَى دَخَلْتُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا آتٍ بِكُمْ إِلَيْهَا،
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

verses.he: וְהָיָ֕ה בַּאֲכָלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَعِنْدَمَا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْ خُبْزِ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَرْفَعُونَ رَفِيعَةً لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall set apart a portion for a gift unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.web: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

verses.he: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: أَوَّلَ عَجِينِكُمْ تَرْفَعُونَ قُرْصًا رَفِيعَةً، كَرَفِيعَةِ ٱلْبَيْدَرِ هَكَذَا تَرْفَعُونَهُ.
verses.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall set apart a cake for a gift; as that which is set apart of the threshing-floor, so shall ye set it apart.
verses.kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough [for] an heave offering: as [ye do] the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.web: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

verses.he: מֵרֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֖תֵיכֶֽם׃ ס
verses.ar: مِنْ أَوَّلِ عَجِينِكُمْ تُعْطُونَ لِلرَّبِّ رَفِيعَةً فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ.
verses.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD a portion for a gift throughout your generations.
verses.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
verses.web: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

verses.he: וְכִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַמִּצְוֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا سَهَوْتُمْ وَلَمْ تَعْمَلُوا جَمِيعَ هَذِهِ ٱلْوَصَايَا ٱلَّتِي كَلَّمَ بِهَا ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى،
verses.en: And when ye shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.kjv: ¶ And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.web: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—

verses.he: אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִן־הַיֹּ֞ום אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה וָהָ֖לְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: جَمِيعَ مَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ عَنْ يَدِ مُوسَى، مِنَ ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلَّذِي أَمَرَ فِيهِ ٱلرَّبُّ فَصَاعِدًا فِي أَجْيَالِكُمْ،
verses.en: even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;
verses.kjv: [Even] all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded [Moses], and henceforward among your generations;
verses.web: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

verses.he: וְהָיָ֗ה אִ֣ם מֵעֵינֵ֣י הָעֵדָה֮ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֣ה לִשְׁגָגָה֒ וְעָשׂ֣וּ כָל־הָעֵדָ֡ה פַּ֣ר בֶּן־בָּקָר֩ אֶחָ֨ד לְעֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָתֹ֥ו וְנִסְכֹּ֖ו כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽת׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ عُمِلَ خُفْيَةً عَنْ أَعْيُنِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ سَهْوًا، يَعْمَلُ كُلُّ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ ثَوْرًا وَاحِدًا ٱبْنَ بَقَرٍ مُحْرَقَةً لِرَائِحَةِ سَرُورٍ لِلرَّبِّ، مَعَ تَقْدِمَتِهِ وَسَكِيبِهِ كَٱلْعَادَةِ، وَتَيْسًا وَاحِدًا مِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ذَبِيحَةَ خَطِيَّةٍ.
verses.en: then it shall be, if it be done in error by the congregation, it being hid from their eyes, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt-offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD — with the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof, according to the ordinance — and one he-goat for a sin-offering.
verses.kjv: Then it shall be, if [ought] be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.web: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

verses.he: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַֽל־כָּל־עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנִסְלַ֣ח לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׁגָגָ֣ה הִ֔וא וְהֵם֩ הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֜ם אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַל־שִׁגְגָתָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَيُكَفِّرُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَنْ كُلِّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ، فَيُصْفَحُ عَنْهُمْ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ سَهْوًا. فَإِذَا أَتَوْا بِقُرْبَانِهِمْ وَقُودًا لِلرَّبِّ، وَبِذَبِيحَةِ خَطِيَّتِهِمْ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِأَجْلِ سَهْوِهِمْ،
verses.en: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin-offering before the LORD, for their error.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it [is] ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
verses.web: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

verses.he: וְנִסְלַ֗ח לְכָל־עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתֹוכָ֑ם כִּ֥י לְכָל־הָעָ֖ם בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ ס
verses.ar: يُصْفَحُ عَنْ كُلِّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَٱلْغَرِيبِ ٱلنَّازِلِ بَيْنَهُمْ، لِأَنَّهُ حَدَثَ لِجَمِيعِ ٱلشَّعْبِ بِسَهْوٍ.
verses.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; for in respect of all the people it was done in error.
verses.kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people [were] in ignorance.
verses.web: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

verses.he: וְאִם־נֶ֥פֶשׁ אַחַ֖ת תֶּחֱטָ֣א בִשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֛יבָה עֵ֥ז בַּת־שְׁנָתָ֖הּ לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.ar: «وَإِنْ أَخْطَأَتْ نَفْسٌ وَاحِدَةٌ سَهْوًا، تُقَرِّبْ عَنْزًا حَوْلِيَّةً ذَبِيحَةَ خَطِيَّةٍ،
verses.en: And if one person sin through error, then he shall offer a she-goat of the first year for a sin-offering.
verses.kjv: ¶ And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.web: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

verses.he: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַל־הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶ֛גֶת בְּחֶטְאָ֥ה בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَيُكَفِّرُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ عَنِ ٱلنَّفْسِ ٱلَّتِي سَهَتْ عِنْدَمَا أَخْطَأَتْ بِسَهْوٍ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ لِلتَّكْفِيرِ عَنْهَا، فَيُصْفَحُ عَنْهَا.
verses.en: And the priest shall make atonement for the soul that erreth, when he sinneth through error, before the LORD, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven,
verses.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.web: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

verses.he: הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתֹוכָ֑ם תֹּורָ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם לָעֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِلْوَطَنِيِّ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلِلْغَرِيبِ ٱلنَّازِلِ بَيْنَهُمْ تَكُونُ شَرِيعَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لِلْعَامِلِ بِسَهْوٍ.
verses.en: both he that is home-born among the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them: ye shall have one law for him that doeth aught in error.
verses.kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, [both for] him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.web: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

verses.he: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה ׀ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֗ה מִן־הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ וּמִן־הַגֵּ֔ר אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא מְגַדֵּ֑ף וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلَّتِي تَعْمَلُ بِيَدٍ رَفِيعَةٍ مِنَ ٱلْوَطَنِيِّينَ أَوْ مِنَ ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ فَهِيَ تَزْدَرِي بِٱلرَّبِّ. فَتُقْطَعُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسُ مِنْ بَيْنِ شَعْبِهَا،
verses.en: But the soul that doeth aught with a high hand, whether he be home-born or a stranger, the same blasphemeth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.kjv: ¶ But the soul that doeth [ought] presumptuously, [whether he be] born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.web: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.he: כִּ֤י דְבַר־יְהוָה֙ בָּזָ֔ה וְאֶת־מִצְוָתֹ֖ו הֵפַ֑ר הִכָּרֵ֧ת ׀ תִּכָּרֵ֛ת הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא עֲוֹנָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃ פ
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهَا ٱحْتَقَرَتْ كَلَامَ ٱلرَّبِّ وَنَقَضَتْ وَصِيَّتَهُ. قَطْعًا تُقْطَعُ تِلْكَ ٱلنَّفْسُ. ذَنْبُهَا عَلَيْهَا».
verses.en: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken His commandment; that soul shall utterly be cut off, his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.kjv: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity [shall be] upon him.
verses.web: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

verses.he: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ אִ֛ישׁ מְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ עֵצִ֖ים בְּיֹ֥ום הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃
verses.ar: وَلَمَّا كَانَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ وَجَدُوا رَجُلًا يَحْتَطِبُ حَطَبًا فِي يَوْمِ ٱلسَّبْتِ.
verses.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.kjv: ¶ And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.web: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

verses.he: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ אֹתֹ֔ו הַמֹּצְאִ֥ים אֹתֹ֖ו מְקֹשֵׁ֣שׁ עֵצִ֑ים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.ar: فَقَدَّمَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ وَجَدُوهُ يَحْتَطِبُ حَطَبًا إِلَى مُوسَى وَهَارُونَ وَكُلِّ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ.
verses.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.kjv: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.web: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

verses.he: וַיַּנִּ֥יחוּ אֹתֹ֖ו בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר כִּ֚י לֹ֣א פֹרַ֔שׁ מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֹֽו׃ ס
verses.ar: فَوَضَعُوهُ فِي ٱلْمَحْرَسِ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُعْلَنْ مَاذَا يُفْعَلُ بِهِ.
verses.en: And they put him in ward, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
verses.kjv: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.web: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה מֹ֥ות יוּמַ֖ת הָאִ֑ישׁ רָגֹ֨ום אֹתֹ֤ו בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِمُوسَى: «قَتْلًا يُقْتَلُ ٱلرَّجُلُ. يَرْجُمُهُ بِحِجَارَةٍ كُلُّ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ خَارِجَ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ».
verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses: 'The man shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.'
verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

verses.he: וַיֹּצִ֨יאוּ אֹתֹ֜ו כָּל־הָעֵדָ֗ה אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתֹ֛ו בָּאֲבָנִ֖ים וַיָּמֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ פ
verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجَهُ كُلُّ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ إِلَى خَارِجِ ٱلْمَحَلَّةِ وَرَجَمُوهُ بِحِجَارَةٍ، فَمَاتَ كَمَا أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى.
verses.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.kjv: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.web: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָ֥תְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: أَنْ يَصْنَعُوا لَهُمْ أَهْدَابًا فِي أَذْيَالِ ثِيَابِهِمْ فِي أَجْيَالِهِمْ، وَيَجْعَلُوا عَلَى هُدْبِ ٱلذَّيْلِ عِصَابَةً مِنْ أَسْمَانْجُونِيٍّ.
verses.en: 'Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them throughout their generations fringes in the corners of their garments, and that they put with the fringe of each corner a thread of blue.
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹתֹ֗ו וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: فَتَكُونُ لَكُمْ هُدْبًا، فَتَرَوْنَهَا وَتَذْكُرُونَ كُلَّ وَصَايَا ٱلرَّبِّ وَتَعْمَلُونَهَا، وَلَا تَطُوفُونَ وَرَاءَ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْيُنِكُمُ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتُمْ فَاسِقُونَ وَرَاءَهَا،
verses.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye go not about after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go astray;
verses.kjv: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.web: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

verses.he: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: لِكَيْ تَذْكُرُوا وَتَعْمَلُوا كُلَّ وَصَايَايَ، وَتَكُونُوا مُقَدَّسِينَ لِإِلَهِكُمْ.
verses.en: that ye may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.web: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

verses.he: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹוצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְיֹ֥ות לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ פ
verses.ar: أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِ مِصْرَ لِيَكُونَ لَكُمْ إِلَهًا. أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكُمْ».
verses.en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.'
verses.kjv: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”
